body:
This is my first experience with AP238. I'm an avid experience report reader, first time reporter. Some background on myself. 28 y/o male 172cm tall approx 75kg weight. It would be quicker to list the (popular) drugs that I haven't used rather than the ones I have. For the propose of this report, seeing as AP238 is an opioid research chemical I'll just have you know that I am a constant user of Opioids for herniated disk at t6-t7. I take tramadol and kratom daily, but on the day of this report I used neither.
I take tramadol and kratom daily, but on the day of this report I used neither.
I also take hydrocodone, oxycodone, morphine, buprinorphine, basically any pharmaceutical grade opiate I can get my hands on when I get the chance. Also, I've used a gram of 2-methyl AP-237 prior to this (over the course of the month of october). So all that is to say I have an opiate tolerance and opiate naive people should start with lower dosages than what I am going to be listing in this report.
Tuesday
4pm
+0 min: Dosed approx 25 mg. The way I figured my dose was with jewelry scales. I measured out .2 (200 mg) and split it into four lines which should be approx 50mg each. I then split one of them in half and re-measured it coming to .18, but my scales always seem to weigh a little light so this is why I'm estimating it at 25mg. I swallowed the powder with a drink of apple juice. Taste wasn't terrible but it did make my tongue go numb for about 2-3 min.
+20 min: I'm starting to feel the beginnings of the effects. I would describe it as a warm starting to wash over me.
I'm doing the dishes and feel as if I'm on auto pilot, things seem less mundane and the constant sharp ache in my back is slightly dulled.
+30 min: Still doing dishes. Had a whoopsie and broke a coffee mug. Can't tell if it's due to loss of motor coordination or if I'm just being clumsy. I'm thinking the latter, as my coordination seems fine otherwise.
+40 min: finished dishes, I think the effects have reached their peak. All in all my headspace is slightly slowed, bit of a happy, content warm feeling. Contemplating dosing the other 25mg.
+60 min: 25mg dosed again, orally. I'm going to put on some music, make a pot of coffee, some sandwiches, & some kraft macaroni and cheese for my wife and I.
+80 min: second dose is kicking in. Now I've reached the level I typically like to be at with opiates. Pain much more dulled and feeling a slow headspace. Body feels a bit heavy but not overwhelmingly so. Just feel 'nice'.
+100 min: drank a cup of coffee
+120 min: feeling is fading now
In conclusion, compared to 2map-237, ap238 seems to be less caustic. The high is similar, but not quite as 'warm' as 237. If I had to compare it to a more well known drug, I would liken it to hydrocodone in its body/headspace. It's duration is fairly short in my experience but that may be due to my opiate tolerance. Not something I plan on using all the time seeing as it's basically a completely unstudied drug. But it certainly does have pleasant (to me) effects.
